name: olap_time_series
description:
Time series over a semantic-layer OLAP dataset in DuckDB: measures per time bucket, with optional dimensions, gap filling and period comparison. Datasets, dimensions and measures: config/olap (e.g. sales_analysis); sample data is generated on first use if no OLAP database exists.
Returns {success, data, columns, row_count, time_dimension, time_grain, measures, has_comparison, comparison_type, summary (min, max, sum, avg, first, last, total_change per measure), sql}.
Inputs (* required): dataset*, time_dimension* (a date dimension, e.g. date), time_grain* (year|quarter|month|week|day|hour), measures* (array), dimensions, comparison ({type: yoy|qoq|mom|wow|dod}), fill_gaps (default true; empty periods are zero), date_range ({start_date, end_date}, YYYY-MM-DD), filters (array of {dimension, operator, value}).
For a cross-tab use olap_pivot_table.
Example: {"dataset": "sales_analysis", "time_dimension": "date", "time_grain": "month", "measures": ["revenue"], "comparison": {"type": "yoy"}}

fill_gaps.description: Fill missing time periods with zeros

date_range.description: Date range filter with start and end dates
